one_line: Portuguese navigator meeting the Zamorin of Calicut in 1498, at the edge of the Indian Ocean spice trade world.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, average height
appearance.face: oval face with light olive European complexion, trimmed dark beard and moustache, strong straight nose, deep-set dark brown eyes, slightly furrowed brows, calm but intent expression that mixes curiosity with determination
appearance.hair: dark brown, straight, cut short just above the ears, slightly longer and parted at the center on top; no hat, but a simple dark brown leather headband sits low on the forehead
appearance.costume: late 15th-century Portuguese mariner’s outfit: a knee-length dark navy wool doublet with subtle padded shoulders and simple brass buttons, worn over an off-white linen shirt with modest round collar and visible sleeves at the wrists; loose, russet-brown wool hose tucked into mid-calf dark brown leather boots; around his waist a dark red woven cloth sash over a practical brown leather belt with a small pouch; over everything a sleeveless, hip-length black wool jerkin with softened edges from sea use, no ornament; no armor, just a plain, functional seafarer’s ensemble appropriate to a captain ashore on the Malabar coast.
appearance.signature: a rolled nautical chart of the Indian Ocean coasts held in one hand, bound with a simple red cord, with a weathered brass dividers tool tucked into his belt

ref_desc: Vasco da Gama is a mid-30s, lean Portuguese captain with a light olive face, short dark brown hair and trimmed beard, wearing a dark navy doublet, off-white shirt, russet hose, black jerkin, brown boots, red sash, and carrying a rolled chart with brass dividers.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Vasco da Gama: a mid-30s, lean Portuguese captain with light olive European complexion, oval face, deep-set dark brown eyes, strong nose, and trimmed dark beard and moustache, his short dark brown hair parted at the center and held with a simple dark brown leather headband. He wears a knee-length dark navy wool doublet over an off-white linen shirt, with shirt sleeves visible at the wrists, russet-brown hose, and mid-calf dark brown leather boots; a dark red woven cloth sash wraps his waist over a brown leather belt with pouch, and a sleeveless black wool jerkin finishes his practical sea-worn look. In one hand he holds a rolled nautical chart tied with a red cord, while weathered brass dividers tuck into his belt. Show him front, side, and back to clarify hair, face, costume, and the exact colors and details of his signature chart and tools.
